summary: SEC-001 (FIR BOLA/IDOR) fix verified end-to-end on api/fir_router.py. Created /app/backend/tests/test_fir_ownership_sec001.py covering all 13 requested endpoints with User A (owner, 200), User B (wrong authenticated user, 403), and unauthenticated (401) scenarios, plus the anti-spoofing check on POST /fir/session, plus a full anonymous no-login regression flow. 51/51 new tests pass. Also re-ran the pre-existing 100 golden tests (unrelated legal-reasoning pipeline) — all still pass, confirming no collateral damage. The previously-reported datetime bug (causing 500s on evidence upload/gps/pause) is also confirmed fixed: all owner-path calls to upload, gps, pause returned 200.
critical_code_review_comments: _get_owned_session() helper in fir_router.py correctly centralizes ownership logic (anon-prefixed/empty user_id = anonymous, owned by session_id knowledge; real user_id requires auth + exact match) and is applied consistently across GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE session+evidence routes.

POST /fir/session anti-spoofing fix correctly ignores body.user_id when an authenticated user calls it (owner_id = user['id'] if user else body.user_id) — verified via GET after create that the real account id was used, not the spoofed 'should-be-ignored' value.
Ownership check in fir_download_evidence/fir_delete_evidence/caption-update routes happens via _get_owned_session before evidence lookup — correct order (403/401 before 404 leak of file existence).
datetime bug fix confirmed: all call sites in fir_router.py now consistently use the aliased `_dt.now(timezone.utc)` import; no remaining module-vs-class datetime.now() misuse found in this file.

Minor non-blocking observation: GET /fir/session/{id}/draft (the separate P0-Fix1 endpoint, not in the explicitly requested list) duplicates the same ownership-check logic inline instead of reusing _get_owned_session() — functionally correct and tested implicitly via test_pdf_* equivalents on draft.pdf, but could be refactored for DRY in a future pass. Not a bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (51/51 new SEC-001 tests; 100/100 pre-existing golden tests unaffected)
success_rate.frontend: Not tested (out of scope per request — backend-only server-side authorization fix, no UI changes)

All test data prefixed with TEST_/anon- for identification; left in DB as inert test fixtures (no cleanup endpoint exists for FIR sessions, consistent with existing test file patterns in this repo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001 fix is fully verified: all 13 requested endpoints correctly return 401 (unauthenticated), 403 (wrong authenticated user), 200 (owner) and 200 (legitimate anonymous session). The anti-spoofing fix on POST /fir/session is verified. Full anonymous FIR flow (create→turn→gps→evidence upload/download/caption→pause→back→draft.pdf→drafts list) works completely unauthenticated with no regressions. The previously-reported datetime bug causing 500s on upload/gps/pause is fixed. No further action needed on this fix; safe to mark SEC-001 as resolved.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a fix-verification pass, not a new bug investigation. Original SEC-001 RCA (per security audit): FIR router endpoints fetched sessions/evidence by session_id/file_id/user_id alone without checking the recorded owner against the authenticated caller, since the Voice FIR flow is anonymous-first and most routes used current_user_optional without any subsequent ownership comparison. Fix introduced a shared _get_owned_session() helper applied to every route, distinguishing anonymous sessions (owned by UUID knowledge) from real-account sessions (owned by exact user.id match), plus forcing POST /fir/session to always use the authenticated caller's own id over any client-supplied user_id.
